item.text:
BLOCKERS:

- Marker discovery is ambiguous when both the current workspace and multiple work-directory ancestors contain markers. Define deterministic precedence and fail on conflicting valid markers; otherwise checkpoint and Stop can select different authorities.
- Path safety lacks a precise contract. Specify whether advertised paths may be absolute, how relative paths resolve, permitted containment boundaries for multi-host mappings, and whether every path component—not merely the final file—is checked for symlinks.
- Registration occurs before the actual-Qwen acceptance fixture. If that fixture exposes a defect, immutable v50 is already registered. Run the representative fixture and Claude review before registration; reserve post-registration work for fresh qualification only.
- Explicitly test marker removal between checkpoint and Stop. The stated “no marker” fallback could silently change authority from marker-selected membership to `hosts.tsv`/`worklist.tsv`; a pending handoff must reject that authority transition even if resulting ledger names happen to match.
